title: Concept: Profile adds a cleartext repository
description: settings.xml declares a profile repository URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a profile repository URL over cleartext.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.xml (maven).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a profile repository URL over cleartext.
